newsitem.title: ECUADOR: Canadian mining firm to invest $100 mln in Ecuador.
newsitem.headline: Canadian mining firm to invest $100 mln in Ecuador.

text.p: Canadian firm Mining Andos plans to invest $100 million to mine in Ecuador's Nambija gold field on the Peruvian border, an Ecuadoran government official said Thursday.
"The Canadians want to invest $100 million in Nambija and they are there at the moment buying land from craft miners," Ecuadoran national overseer for corporations Oswaldo Lucero told Reuters.

He added that according to a Mining Andos report, Ecuadorans mining on their own recover 40 percent of the gold and waste about 60 percent while the Canadian firm committed itself to reduce the waste to about 30 percent.
Nambija is in the coastal province of El Oro, 340 miles (540 km) south of Quito.
Ecuador produced almost 500,000 ounces troy of gold last year. Congress is analyzing a new mining law to foster more private investments.
